description: Makes the Suppliers Net page where a signed-in person can ask one supplier for a quote on one item. This tool sends nothing and asks for nothing: the person opens the link, signs in, checks the request and presses send themselves, and only that supplier sees their details. Give the supplier's name or profile link (from find_suppliers) and the item. Ordering from a supplier that sells through Suppliers Net happens on that supplier's page, also by a person.

item.description: What the person wants, with the amount if known, e.g. '20 kg raw king prawns'.

supplier.description: The supplier's name, or the profile link find_suppliers returned.

name: quote_link
title: Link for a person to ask a supplier for a quote
